# InlineQueryResultCachedAudio

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.InlineQueryResultCachedAudio`

## Documentation

A link to an MP3 audio file stored on the Telegram servers

By default, this audio file will be sent by the user. Alternatively, you can use *input_message_content* to send a
message with the specified content instead of the audio.

### Parameters

- **`audio_file_id`** (`str`)
  A valid file identifier for the audio file.

- **`id`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes.
  Defaults to a randomly generated UUID4.

- **`caption`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Caption of the photo to be sent, 0-1024 characters.

- **`parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  By default, texts are parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.
  You can combine both syntaxes together.

- **`caption_entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](../messages_and_media/MessageEntity.md))
  List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*.

- **`reply_markup`** ([`InlineKeyboardMarkup`](../bots_and_keyboards/InlineKeyboardMarkup.md), *optional*)
  An InlineKeyboardMarkup object.

- **`input_message_content`** ([`InputMessageContent`](../input_message_content/InputMessageContent.md))
  Content of the message to be sent instead of the photo.
